claim: In Gravesend water must run where its fall says: the owner found the water above the stockyard fall running away from it. Currents above a fall run toward the fall. Gravesend met both with channels running toward an outfall or basin, landings running fast toward the main channel, and barred culverts out of the pools.

The pool's way out is recorded as his rule only in the agent's notes, unquoted.
